_about: Sample reports for the offline demo only. Task wording is simplified and the placements were written by hand to preview the app. They are not O*NET text and not an AI analysis. Ratings: L=Low, M=Moderate, H=High; '+' leans higher, '-' leans lower. Task format: [label, category, AI exposure, human advantage, task description, why it is placed here].

careers.title: Veterinarians
careers.summary: Most of a vet's work is hands-on care and trusted conversations, where people clearly lead. AI mainly helps with reading images, records, and paperwork.
takeaways: Hands-on care and surgery stay firmly human for now.
AI is becoming a strong helper for reading X-rays and writing records.
Comforting worried owners and earning their trust is a lasting strength.
nextSteps: Take biology and chemistry, including AP classes if your school offers them.
Volunteer at an animal shelter, clinic, or farm.
Join 4-H, FFA, or a pre-vet club.
Ask a local vet if you can shadow them for a day.
tasks: Examining animals to find illness or injury
Examine animals to figure out what kind of illness or injury they have.
AI can suggest possible causes from symptoms, but the hands-on exam and final judgment stay with the vet.
Treat sick or injured animals with medicine, bandages, setting bones, or surgery.
Surgery and treatment need skilled hands and quick decisions that AI can't do.
Use X-ray and ultrasound machines and interpret the images.
AI image tools are good at spotting patterns, and the vet confirms them using the whole picture of the animal.
Advising owners on care and treatment
Advise owners about feeding, care, health conditions, and treatment options.
AI can draft care instructions, but owners trust a real conversation with their vet.
Counsel owners about a pet's death or end-of-life decisions.
Compassion and trust during hard moments are deeply human.
Vaccinate animals against diseases such as rabies.
A routine hands-on procedure: AI can't do it, but it's also highly standardized.
Collect blood, urine, or tissue samples for testing.
Physical and routine, so neither AI nor special human judgment stands out.
Educating the public about animal diseases
Teach the public about diseases that can spread from animals to people.
AI can draft clear materials quickly, and vets add expertise and credibility.
Train and supervise people who handle and care for animals.
Coaching people and leading a team relies on human relationships.
Keep records of exams, treatments, and services.
AI can write and organize records from notes or recordings very well.
Handle appointments, payments, and other business tasks.
Scheduling and billing are routine digital work that software already handles.
Research diseases that animals could catch.
AI speeds up reading studies and analyzing data, and scientists still frame the questions.

careers.title: Software Developers
careers.summary: Software development is one of the careers most touched by AI. Routine coding and testing can be sped up a lot, while design, judgment, and understanding people stay human.
takeaways: AI tools already write a lot of routine code, so learning to use them well matters.
The most valuable developers decide what to build and make sure it really works.
Communication and teamwork matter as much as coding skill.
nextSteps: Take computer science and math classes, including AP Computer Science if offered.
Build a small app or website for a club or local group.
Join a robotics team or coding club, or enter a hackathon.
Practice explaining your code to someone who doesn't code.
tasks: Write code for standard features based on a plan.
AI coding assistants can produce much of this code, and people review and adjust it.
Designing how a software system fits together
Plan how the parts of a software system connect and work together.
AI can suggest options, but weighing trade-offs for a real project takes experienced judgment.
Talk with users and clients to learn what the software must do.
Listening, asking good questions, and reading between the lines are human strengths.
Find and fix problems in software.
AI can spot many bugs, and tricky ones still need a developer who understands the whole system.
Write guides that explain how the software works.
AI can draft clear documentation from code and notes.
Write and run tests to make sure software works.
AI can generate and run many tests automatically.
Check other developers' code for quality and mistakes.
AI flags issues fast, and people judge whether the code fits the team's goals.
Deciding what to build and why
Decide which features matter most and why.
Setting direction depends on understanding people, business, and priorities.
Estimating time and cost of projects
Estimate how long work will take and what it will cost.
AI can use past data to help, but estimates depend on knowing the team.
Protect software and data from attacks.
AI scans for known weaknesses, and people think like attackers and decide on fixes.
Update older code so it keeps working.
AI tools are good at reading and modernizing old code.
Working with teams and clients on goals
Meet with teammates and clients to plan and agree on goals.
Building trust and agreement among people is a human skill.

careers.title: Public Relations Specialists
careers.summary: This career mixes routine writing that AI handles well with relationship and judgment work where people clearly lead.
takeaways: AI can speed up drafting, monitoring, and basic reporting a lot.
The biggest career value is in strategy, trust, and handling tough moments.
Strong writers who also build relationships will stand out.
nextSteps: Join the school newspaper, yearbook, or a club's social media team.
Take English, speech, and a statistics or data class.
Practice writing a press release for a school event.
Interview someone who works in communications about their week.
tasks: Write press releases and other materials for the media.
AI writes solid first drafts quickly, and people check the facts, tone, and message.
Monitoring news and social media coverage
Track what news outlets and social media say about the organization.
AI tools can scan huge amounts of coverage and sum up the mood.
Posting updates to websites and social media
Post and update content on the website and social media.
Scheduling and formatting posts is routine digital work.
Gather numbers and write regular reports on results.
AI can pull data together and summarize it.
Plan programs that shape how the public sees the organization.
AI helps brainstorm and research, and people set the strategy and make the calls.
Prepare speeches and messages for leaders.
AI drafts quickly, but capturing a leader's voice and the right moment takes human judgment.
Study what audiences think and care about.
AI analyzes surveys and online data fast, and people decide what it means.
Build and keep good relationships with reporters and community groups.
Trust is built person to person over time.
Advise leaders on what to say and do when something goes wrong.
High-stakes moments need calm judgment and trust.
Speak for the organization at public events.
Being present and personable in public is a human strength.
Mostly planning and follow-up; tools help some, and it isn't a strong human edge.
Send out and keep track of materials.
Simple, repeatable work that's easy to streamline.

careers.title: Registered Nurses
careers.summary: Nursing is mostly hands-on care, fast decisions, and human connection, where people clearly lead. AI is growing as a helper for charting, monitoring, and catching errors.
takeaways: Most nursing tasks land in Human Strengths.
AI helps with charting and alerts, which can free up more time for patients.
Calm communication under pressure is a core nursing skill.
nextSteps: Take biology, chemistry, anatomy, and health science if offered.
Get certified in CPR or first aid.
Volunteer at a hospital, clinic, or senior center.
Look into nurse aide (CNA) programs or a health careers club like HOSA.
tasks: Give patients medicines and treatments safely.
Hands-on care and constant watchfulness are human work.
Watch patients' vital signs and changes in their condition.
Monitors and AI alerts catch warning signs, and nurses notice what machines miss.
Record symptoms, care given, and how patients respond.
AI can turn notes or speech into charts quickly.
Support patients and families who are scared or upset.
Empathy and presence can't be automated.
Teaching patients how to care for themselves
Explain how to manage health at home.
AI can make clear handouts, and nurses tailor the message to each person.
Act fast when a patient's condition suddenly gets worse.
Quick physical action and judgment under pressure are human.
Coordinating care with doctors and teams
Work with doctors and other staff on each patient's care.
Teamwork and speaking up for patients depend on people.
Software is strong at catching dose and drug-interaction errors, and nurses make the final check.
Create a care plan for each patient.
AI can suggest standard plans, and nurses adjust them for the real person.
Set up rooms, supplies, and equipment.
Physical but routine work; neither side stands out.
Order and keep track of medical supplies.
Inventory systems can handle much of this.
Guide and supervise aides and less experienced nurses.

careers.title: Electricians
careers.summary: Electrical work is hands-on and happens in real buildings, so most tasks are Human Strengths. AI mostly helps with planning, code lookups, and paperwork.
takeaways: Hands-on skilled trades like this have low AI exposure.
New work in areas like solar panels and EV chargers is growing.
Strong math and safety habits matter every day.
nextSteps: Take algebra, physics, and any shop or construction classes.
Look into career and technical education (CTE) programs for electrical trades.
Ask about pre-apprenticeship or apprenticeship programs near you.
Build a simple circuit kit project at home or school.
tasks: Install wiring, outlets, panels, and fixtures.
Skilled physical work in real buildings is far beyond today's AI.
Read plans and diagrams to know what to build.
AI can help read plans, and electricians match them to the real site.
Track down and repair electrical problems.
AI can suggest causes, but hands-on troubleshooting is a human skill.
Testing circuits with meters and tools
Test circuits with meters to check they're safe and working.
Hands-on testing needs a person on site.
Make sure work meets electrical codes.
AI can look up code rules quickly, and electricians apply them on the job.
Plan where wiring goes and how much material is needed.
Software and AI can do much of the layout math and material lists.
Installing solar panels and EV chargers
Install solar panels, batteries, and car chargers.
A growing area of hands-on work.
Working safely in tight or high spaces
Work safely on ladders, in attics, and in crawl spaces.
Physical skill and safety awareness are human.
Explaining work and costs to customers
Explain repairs, options, and costs to customers.
AI can help write quotes, and trust comes from talking with the electrician.
Fill out permits, invoices, and job reports.
Routine paperwork is easy to automate.
Do routine checks and upkeep on electrical equipment.
Routine and physical, so neither side stands out.
Teach and supervise apprentices on the job.
Passing on hands-on skill is human work.

careers.title: Mechanical Engineers
careers.summary: Mechanical engineering mixes heavy computer work that AI can speed up with hands-on testing and teamwork where people lead.
takeaways: AI is speeding up calculations, simulations, and reports.
Creative problem solving and real-world testing stay human strengths.
Engineers who use AI tools well can design faster and better.
nextSteps: Take physics, calculus, and any engineering or CAD classes.
Join robotics, Science Olympiad, or an engineering club.
Learn a free CAD tool and design something you can 3D print.
Enter a science fair with a build-and-test project.
tasks: Designing machines and parts with CAD
Design machines and parts using computer-aided design (CAD) software.
AI design tools suggest shapes and options, and engineers decide what will actually work.
Run calculations and computer simulations of how designs will perform.
Computers and AI do this math faster than people.
Build and test early versions of a design.
Hands-on testing and noticing what went wrong are human strengths.
Figure out why a design isn't working and how to fix it.
AI offers ideas, and framing the real problem takes human creativity.
AI can draft technical writing from data and notes.
Research materials and ways to make things.
AI speeds up research, and engineers judge what fits the project.
Work with the people who build the product.
Collaboration on the factory floor is human.
Inspect machines and equipment in person.
On-site inspection needs a person there.
Estimate how much projects will cost and how long they'll take.
Software and AI handle much of the estimating.
Lead teams and projects from idea to finished product.
Make sure designs meet safety rules and standards.
AI can check against rules, and engineers carry the responsibility and judgment.
Data entry and organizing are easy to automate.

careers.title: Lawyers
careers.summary: AI can already do a lot of legal research and document work. Advising clients, arguing in court, and negotiating stay deeply human.
takeaways: Research and document review are changing fast because of AI.
Judgment, persuasion, and client trust are the lasting core of the job.
Strong writers and speakers who use AI well will have an edge.
nextSteps: Take English, government, history, and speech or debate.
Join debate, mock trial, or Model UN.
Write opinion pieces for the school paper.
Sit in on a public court hearing, or ask a lawyer about their work.
tasks: Research laws and past court decisions.
AI legal research tools find relevant cases quickly, and lawyers verify them.
Write contracts, wills, and other legal documents.
AI drafts quickly, and lawyers tailor documents and catch risks.
Explain legal options and give advice to clients.
Clients rely on a lawyer's judgment and trust.
Present cases and argue in front of judges and juries.
Persuading people in a courtroom is human work.
Negotiate agreements with the other side.
Reading people and building agreement are human strengths.
Review large amounts of documents for evidence.
AI can sort and flag documents much faster than people.
Interview clients and witnesses to learn the facts.
Building trust and noticing what people don't say is human.
Decide the overall plan for a case.
AI helps explore options, and strategy needs human judgment.
Summarize long case files and records.
Summarizing documents is a strong AI skill.
Check documents against rules and regulations.
AI can check documents against rules quickly.
Write formal legal arguments for the court.
AI can draft, and lawyers must shape the argument and check every source.
Routine tracking that software handles well.

careers.title: Graphic Designers
careers.summary: AI image and design tools are changing graphic design quickly. Understanding clients, creative direction, and judging quality stay human.
takeaways: AI can quickly make images, resize designs, and prepare files.
Creative direction and understanding the client are where designers stand out.
A strong portfolio and good taste matter more than ever.
nextSteps: Take art, digital design, and photography classes.
Build a portfolio of 6 to 8 of your best pieces.
Design posters or social posts for a school club or event.
Try free design tools and study designs you admire.
tasks: Creating design concepts and sample layouts
Create design ideas, concepts, and sample layouts.
AI can generate many options, and designers choose and shape the right one.
Create new images using design software.
AI image tools can create images from a description.
Choose fonts and arrange text and images.
AI suggests layouts, and designers judge what looks right.
Meeting clients to understand what they need
Meet with clients to learn their goals.
Understanding people's real goals is human.
Research who the design is for.
AI speeds up research, and designers interpret it.
Routine technical steps that software can automate.
Design logos and the look of a brand.
AI helps explore ideas, and meaning and originality come from people.
Taste and creative judgment are human strengths.
Adjust designs for different sizes and platforms.
AI tools can resize and reformat automatically.
Present designs to clients and respond to feedback.
Keeping an archive of images and past work
Keep an organized archive of images and past work.
Organizing files is easy to automate.
Give instructions to the people who print and produce designs.
Routine coordination; neither side stands out.
